Elemental Dancer: Novice at 1, Intermediate at 3, Advanced at 5, Expert at 8, Master at 11, Grandmaster(mastered weapons at 11)

The Dancer class is an elemental warrior, focused on combat, body and mind, combined with their magical element of choice. They slowly learn to control their body, their mind, and then their element in that order. They are well trained and focused. Sometimes the element they choose affects their emotions and outlook and they must guard against this.
Elementalist: Beginner at 1, Novice at 5, Intermediate at 10, Advanced at 15, Expert at 20, Master at 25

Elementalists are as connected to the elemental sources as traditional Mages are to Aura and spell casting. They can directly control and call into being the powers of the elements in the form of elementals and related kinetics. They can bind the elements to the earthly plane and can control the elements within earthly forms with various lore. They are at home in most environments and always searching for more elemental lore to add to their specialized knowledge.
+10% to Magic Resistance against elemental-based magic.
Any leather or hide. Half helm or composite helm. No headgear but leather.
Club, dagger, knife, quarterstaff, rod, sling.
+10% to Magic Resistance against elemental-based magic.
Summoner: Beginner at 1, Novice at 3, Intermediate at 5, Advanced at 8, Expert at 10, Master at 12

The Summoner uses a combination of magical, and divine powers to summon and control, first animals, then elementals, followed by humanoids, and finally supernatural beings. A Summoner can also temporarily summon any object they ever touched. In order to pursue their later abilities, they have to find enough information to summon supernatural beings or creatures. This goal can be difficult and thus many Summoners fall short of full control of more than a very few of the supernatural. The summoner's eventual ability to use Thought Projection and then Retain Control allows indefinite control of others. Summoners are thus amazing controllers as well. Their limitation is they are passive. They have no direct abilities and must rely on those they have summoned or controlled to act for them. Most Summoners begin their careers with at least one animal companion they have selected who is strong enough to fight for them, and later supplement with elemental and then supernatural beings or creatures.
Any leather/hide. Half helm or composite helm. No headgear but leather.
Club, dagger, knife, quarterstaff, rod, sling.
Inquisitor: Beginner at 1, Novice at 4, Intermediate at 7, Advanced at 10, Expert at 13, Master at 15

When the time comes to cull the herd and remove the weak links. Someone must weed out the heretics, charlatans and true blasphemers. The Inquisitor revels in such efforts. The truth serves them. Lies serve them. The fear of death serves them and even death is not an escape for the powerful Inquisitor. They question even the recently dead. These fanatical priests cannot be reasoned with. They cannot be bribed. They see only the holy righteous fires of their fanatical cause. Nothing is too extreme for their cause. The loss of a few innocents or weaklings is not too high a price to pay for the strength of the faithful. Besides, they will be saved in the next life if they are truly worthy, but few are. They go after the very soul of their targets, using it against their foes. Even this is not too extreme and thus only rarely are they truly sanctioned by their deities in times when the faith is flagging and heretical teachings are on the rise. An Inquisitor can be good or evil as long as they are fanatical and have a cause to serve.
Any leather or hide. Any half helm, and arm bracer. No headgear but leather.
GME: GME (The Game Master Extra). Any individual from the race who does not have a particular class but may be needed in a fight or for their skills.
